cards.title: Board loads blank after login on Firefox 124
cards.description:
Reported by 3 users. Board appears empty immediately after login on Firefox 124.0. Works on Chrome and Safari.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Log in on Firefox 124
2. Navigate to any board
3. Board renders blank — no columns visible
4. Hard refresh fixes it

checklist.text: Check browser console for JS errors

comments.body: Reproduced. Root cause: race condition in board hydration on Firefox. Fix in progress.
comments.author: demo1
